{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per `patient_id`
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Cross-tabulate arm by severity
df_dedup[['arm', 'severity']].value_counts().unstack(fill_value=0)"}
